messages:
DeployBot: Deploy completed: blue->green header-rewrite rollout v2.3.1 started at 12:04 UTC, canary 5% EU. No immediate errors from CI.
SRE-Bot: :rotating_light: Alert: 504 spike on eu-west-1 edge from 12:08. Rate +120%, error budget burning. Paging oncall_pager.
oncall_pager: oncall here, looking now. Linking to traces and logs.
Alex: seeing a lot of upstream 502/504s from edge-proxy-1. Quick grep shows `x-routing-anchor` header missing on many requests. Could be the header rewrite not propagated to some edge pools.
Maya: ugh, we switched header anchoring in the new route rule. Canary should only affect EU but telemetry shows APAC edges also receiving mixed headers. Reverting canary weight is my next action unless we can patch.
Jonas: I see the same. Logs from edge-proxy-ap-southeast-1 show requests with original header and some with `x-routing-anchor: blue`. Oddly backends in EU are rejecting requests without the header.
Priya: tagging infra: did the envoy config push succeed globally? I ran `kubectl -n edge rolling-restart edge-config-2029` but rollout might have stalled.
DeployBot: Rollout step: pushed envoy route filter v2.3.1 -> applied to replicas in eu-west-1 and us-west-2. APAC targets queued (pending config-manager rollout).
Alex: Can someone run a curl test hitting eu vs apac edge with header inspection? Example test:

```
curl -s -D - -o /dev/null 'https://api.redwood.example/health' -H 'Host: api.redwood.example' | grep -i x-routing-anchor
```

I ran it from a probe and got no header on APAC, `x-routing-anchor: blue` on EU.
Maya: Paging product-sdks for customer impact: are we seeing client errors surfaced as 5xx in app logs or just edge timeouts?
Jonas: Backend returns 400 if header missing (guard clause added in v2). So stack is returning 400 -> edge maps to 502/504 depending on timeout. Customers seeing failed LLM requests.
SRE-Bot: Customer impact: ~2.3% of requests globally, concentrated EU traffic routed through APAC edges (due to previous geo-weighting). Impact window: 12:08-12:30 so far. Open incident ticket: INC-2029.
oncall_pager: I'm going to flip canary back to 0 in EU and lift the rollout. Executing:

```
deployctl set-weight header-rewrite v2.3.1 --region eu-west-1 0
```

Executing now.
DeployBot: Command accepted. Weight change in progress. Canary EU -> 0%.
Maya: After lowering to 0, error rate dropped ~85% in 2m. Still seeing stragglers from APAC edges for EU-sourced requests.
Alex: Theory: config-manager applied envoy filter only on control plane nodes in EU, but edge proxies reading stale config from CDN cache. Need to invalidate config cache or force config push to edge-proxies in APAC.
Priya: Kicking off force push to edge-proxies in apac: `kubectl -n edge rollout restart daemonset/edge-proxy --selector=region=ap-southeast-1` — doing sequential restarts to avoid mass reconnect.
Jonas: Also temporarily relaxing backend header guard to accept requests without `x-routing-anchor` until we can confirm stable rollout. Patch PR ready:

```
service: accept-missing-anchor: true  # temporary
```

Maya: Agree. Patch applied to backend (hotfix) and deployed to EU backends. Monitoring.
SRE-Bot: Deploy of backend patch succeeded at 12:18.
Alex: After proxy restarts and backend guard relaxation, 5xx/4xx errors fell to baseline at 12:22.
Priya: Confirmed APAC proxy config now shows the header rewrite rule present. It looks like the CDN config TTL caused delayed propagation; edge config-manager didn't force TTL expiry earlier.
oncall_pager: Good. Next steps: investigate why config-manager didn't push to all regions simultaneously; add test for header-rewrite propagation and TTL handling in the rollout playbook.
Maya: Noting customer impact: external customers using streaming LLM endpoints saw increased failures (timeouts / broken streams). We have a list of affected accounts from logs (redacted here). Product will follow up on communication.
Jonas: Running post-incident checks: stacktrace sampling, token counts, and latency histograms. No data loss; retries handled by client-side best-effort.
Alex: Handoff: I'm stepping out in 20m. @Maya please take primary follow-up and coordinate with infra on config-manager fix.
Maya: Taking handoff. I'll open a JIRA for config-manager TTL issue and a runbook update to include an immediate CDN-cache invalidation step when header-based route rules are rolled out. Also adding automated smoke tests that verify header presence from multiple global vantage points before increasing weight.
SRE-Bot: Incident INC-2029: status -> mitigated, timeline recorded, severity P2. Follow-ups assigned: CONF-345 (config-manager fix), RB-129 (runbook/update), COMM-77 (customer comms).
Maya: Quick customer impact summary draft for postmortem:
- Incident start: 12:08 UTC upon partial rollout of header-rewrite for blue->green routing.
- Root cause: header-rewrite envoy filter did not propagate to APAC edge proxies due to CDN/config TTL and an incomplete force-push mechanism.
- Impact: ~2.3% of requests globally; affected streaming LLM endpoints with higher error rates primarily for EU-origin traffic routed through APAC edge.
- Mitigation: immediate canary rollback, force restart of APAC edge proxies, backend guard relaxation, and follow-up patches. Errors back to baseline by 12:22 UTC.
- Action items: CONF-345, RB-129, automated global smoke.

I'll draft the full postmortem and notify support/product for customer outreach. :white_check_mark:
DeployBot: Deploy event closed. No further action required on rollout v2.3.1 until follow-ups completed.
SRE-Bot: Closing thread. If anything regresses, reopen INC-2029 and page oncall.
Maya: Thanks everyone. Will post postmortem draft by EOD and ping execs for customer-risk review. :thumbsup:
